datasets.name: scorecard
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(contoso_facility_id, ' ', contoso_facility_name) AS facility,
  contoso_facility_id,
  facility_id AS ccn,
  measure,
  fiscal_year,
  excess_readmission_ratio AS err,
  penalty_cutoff,
  cutoff_is_approximate,
  above_cutoff,
  CASE WHEN above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_cutoff_n,
  err_change,
  anomaly_flag
FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
WHERE fiscal_year = :fiscal_year

datasets.name: scorecard_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN above_cutoff THEN contoso_facility_id END) AS facilities_above,
  SUM(CASE WHEN above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conditions_above,
  COUNT(excess_readmission_ratio) AS pairs_reported,
  ROUND(AVG(excess_readmission_ratio), 3) AS mean_err
FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
WHERE fiscal_year = :fiscal_year

datasets.name: err_trend
datasets.displayName: ERR trend: Contoso, Ohio, all hospitals
queryLines:
SELECT 'All hospitals' AS hospital_group, fiscal_year, measure, excess_readmission_ratio AS err
FROM gold_facility_condition_year
WHERE excess_readmission_ratio IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Ohio' AS hospital_group, fiscal_year, measure, excess_readmission_ratio AS err
FROM gold_facility_condition_year
WHERE excess_readmission_ratio IS NOT NULL AND state = 'OH'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Contoso' AS hospital_group, fiscal_year, measure, excess_readmission_ratio AS err
FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
WHERE excess_readmission_ratio IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: penalized_share
datasets.displayName: Share of hospitals penalized by year
queryLines:
SELECT
  fiscal_year,
  CASE WHEN cutoff_is_approximate THEN 'Approximate cutoff (1.0 stand-in)'
       ELSE 'Exact cutoff' END AS cutoff_basis,
  COUNT(*) AS hospitals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN penalized THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS penalized,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN penalized THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS penalized_share
FROM gold_penalty_mart
WHERE conditions_reported > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: penalized_by_state
datasets.displayName: Hospitals penalized by state, latest year
queryLines:
SELECT
  state,
  COUNT(*) AS hospitals,
  SUM(CASE WHEN penalized THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS penalized,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN penalized THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 3) AS penalized_share,
  ROUND(AVG(mean_err), 3) AS mean_err
FROM gold_penalty_mart
WHERE conditions_reported > 0
  AND state IS NOT NULL
  AND fiscal_year = (SELECT MAX(fiscal_year) FROM gold_penalty_mart)
GROUP BY state

datasets.name: predictions_contoso
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(contoso_facility_id, ' ', contoso_facility_name) AS facility,
  c.contoso_facility_id,
  p.measure,
  p.target_fiscal_year,
  ROUND(p.penalty_probability, 3) AS penalty_probability,
  p.predicted_above_cutoff,
  CASE WHEN p.predicted_above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS predicted_above_n,
  p.above_cutoff_lag1 AS above_cutoff_last_year,
  CASE WHEN p.above_cutoff_lag1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above_last_year_n,
  p.risk_decile,
  p.risk_rank,
  p.model_name,
  p.model_version,
  p.scored_at
FROM gold_penalty_predictions p
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT contoso_facility_id, contoso_facility_name, facility_id
  FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
) c ON p.facility_id = c.facility_id

datasets.name: predictions_by_measure
datasets.displayName: FY2028 predictions by condition, all hospitals
queryLines:
SELECT
  measure,
  COUNT(*) AS pairs,
  ROUND(AVG(penalty_probability), 3) AS mean_probability,
  SUM(CASE WHEN predicted_above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS predicted_above
FROM gold_penalty_predictions
GROUP BY measure

datasets.name: followup
datasets.displayName: Follow-up calls by facility and condition
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(contoso_facility_id, ' ', contoso_facility_name) AS facility,
  contoso_facility_id,
  measure,
  fiscal_year,
  contoso_months,
  contoso_discharges,
  calls_attempted,
  calls_completed,
  calls_completed_within_72h,
  ROUND(followup_rate, 3) AS followup_rate,
  ROUND(followup_within_72h_rate, 3) AS followup_within_72h_rate,
  ROUND(calls_completed / NULLIF(calls_attempted, 0), 3) AS completed_of_attempted,
  above_cutoff,
  cutoff_is_approximate
FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
WHERE fiscal_year = :fiscal_year AND contoso_months > 0

datasets.name: followup_facility
queryLines:
SELECT
  concat(contoso_facility_id, ' ', contoso_facility_name) AS facility,
  MAX(contoso_months) AS contoso_months,
  SUM(contoso_discharges) AS discharges,
  SUM(calls_completed) AS calls_completed,
  ROUND(SUM(calls_completed) / NULLIF(SUM(contoso_discharges), 0), 3) AS followup_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(calls_completed_within_72h) / NULLIF(SUM(contoso_discharges), 0), 3)
    AS followup_within_72h_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conditions_above_cutoff,
  CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN above_cutoff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       THEN 'Has a condition above the cutoff' ELSE 'No condition above the cutoff' END
    AS penalty_status
FROM gold_contoso_scorecard
WHERE fiscal_year = :fiscal_year
GROUP BY 1
HAVING MAX(contoso_months) > 0

datasets.name: run_summary
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT
    job_run_id,
    MIN(started_at) AS run_started,
    MAX(ended_at) AS run_ended,
    COUNT(*) AS task_attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts
  FROM ops_run_log
  GROUP BY job_run_id
)
SELECT
  job_run_id,
  run_started,
  run_ended,
  CASE WHEN failed_attempts > 0 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'succeeded' END AS run_status,
  task_attempts,
  failed_attempts,
  ROUND((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - unix_timestamp(run_ended)) / 3600, 1)
    AS hours_since_run_ended,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_dq_metrics WHERE NOT passed) AS failed_dq_checks
FROM runs
ORDER BY run_started DESC
LIMIT 1

datasets.name: task_latest
queryLines:
SELECT
  task,
  status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  ROUND((unix_timestamp(ended_at) - unix_timestamp(started_at)) / 60, 1) AS minutes,
  rows_written,
  error,
  job_run_id
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY task ORDER BY ended_at DESC) AS attempt_rank
  FROM ops_run_log
)
WHERE attempt_rank = 1

datasets.name: task_durations
queryLines:
SELECT
  r.job_run_id,
  MIN(r.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY r.job_run_id) AS run_started,
  r.task,
  r.status,
  ROUND((unix_timestamp(r.ended_at) - unix_timestamp(r.started_at)) / 60, 1) AS minutes
FROM ops_run_log r

datasets.name: dq_failed
queryLines:
SELECT job_run_id, task, table_name, metric, value, threshold, measured_at
FROM ops_dq_metrics
WHERE NOT passed

lines:
## Contoso Health scorecard
Which of our facilities and conditions are above the penalty cutoff this year? FY2027 is the latest HRRP year and the default.

*Contoso Health is a fictional client. Its 12 facilities are real public Ohio CMS Certification Numbers relabeled with invented names; the CMS numbers are public, and no Contoso number describes a real hospital.*

frame.title: Facilities with a condition above the cutoff
Conditions above the cutoff, by facility

lines: Cutoffs for FY2019 to FY2026 are approximate: CMS compared each hospital with the median ERR of its dual-eligibility peer group, which no file in this project carries, so 1.0 stands in (`cutoff_is_approximate = true`). FY2013 to FY2018 (1.0) and FY2027 (the published peer group median) are exact.

How does our readmission ratio trend compare with Ohio and national hospitals? Mean ERR per fiscal year, FY2013 to FY2027. An ERR above the cutoff means more readmissions than CMS expected for that hospital's patients.

lines: Cutoffs for FY2019 to FY2026 are approximate: CMS compared each hospital with the median ERR of its dual-eligibility peer group, which no file in this project carries, so 1.0 stands in (`cutoff_is_approximate = true`). FY2013 to FY2018 (1.0) and FY2027 (the published peer group median) are exact. The bar colors show which years rest on the stand-in. A hospital counts as penalized when at least one condition is above the cutoff; the Gold tables carry no payment adjustment factor, so no page estimates the penalty's size.
Which of our facility and condition pairs does the model expect above the cutoff next cycle? Probabilities from the `penalty_model` champion (LightGBM), scored into `gold_penalty_predictions`.

lines: These are probabilities, not forecasts of the ERR or the penalty amount. The model scored test AUC 0.874 on FY2026, whose labels use the approximate 1.0 cutoff, but only 0.678 on FY2027, the one recent year with the exact peer-median cutoff, and its FY2027 probabilities are overconfident at both ends (rows under 0.1 were above the cutoff 22 percent of the time, rows over 0.9 only 76 percent). FY2028 follows FY2027, so expect accuracy closer to the lower figure. Use the ranking to decide where to look first. See `docs/model-card.md`.

## Follow-up operations
Where is follow-up call completion lowest, and is it where we are penalized? Rates are completed post-discharge calls over all-payer discharges in Contoso's own records, over the months of the fiscal year's performance window.

*Contoso's operational data is synthetic and starts in September 2023, so only FY2026 (10 months) and FY2027 (22 months) have it.*

frame.title: Follow-up rate by facility, lowest first
Facility and condition, lowest follow-up rate first

lines: A low follow-up rate beside a condition above the cutoff is a place to look, not evidence that calls lower the ERR: that is the question the follow-up pilot is designed to test. A facility's penalty status counts every condition above the cutoff, including the few Contoso has no call records for, which the table leaves out. FY2026 cutoffs are the approximate 1.0 stand-in; FY2027's are exact.
Is the data pipeline healthy? From `ops_run_log` (one row per task attempt) and `ops_dq_metrics` (every expectation's value and threshold). A run started for a subset of tasks counts as a run.
